DeSantis is the single biggest traitor in MAGA history, and Vance is arguably the most loyal ally Trump has ever had in a major politician. 

Meatball Ron is only relevant because Trump created his entire career. He was nothing but a Trump simp. He told us over and over again he would not run against Trump, and while he was saying that he was secretly building a network of anti-a Trump shills, selling out to all of Trump’s biggest enemies. He sold his sole to Trump-hater Rupert Murdoch for an ungodly amount of money. Then he used the money to buy off The Dialy Wire and Babylon Bee and turn them against Trump. He has zero loyalty. 

If loyalty means nothing to you, you can’t possibly be MAGA. America was built with honor and loyalty, not stabbing the guy in the back who gave you the opportunity of a lifetime. Personality wise, DeSantis has more in common with Kamala than Trump.

If he won in 2024, all January 6ers would still be in prison. He demanded their arrests at the time. And Trump might even be in prison himself. He also called Derek Chauvin a murderer and demanded his arrest. He also didn’t lift a finger to help George Zimmerman, a constituent in his district of Congress. He then went on to hire Pam Bondi, the person who started the Trayvon Martin witch hunt.

His record is mostly fraudulent. It’s smoke and mirrors. Fake fights with Disney. Fake executive orders that are never enforced. Redundant legislation that changes nothing. He is a Fox News candidate who does very little but is constantly on Fox boasting about his major accomplishments. Anything he actually did achieve, he did so for the express purpose of “taking Trump’s voters without pissing them off for betraying Trump.” He actually said this on a hot mic, recorded by Matt Gaetz.

DeSantis is an unholy hybrid of Jeb Bush and Mitt Romney. Yes, he is better than any Democrat, by far. But among republicans he is possibly the single worst person you could ever pick. He is not trustworthy. He is a lying lawyerly son of a bitch. His wife wears the pants and all he wants is power. MAGA is just a vehicle through which he hopes to gain power, at which point he will take us back to the years of Bush cuckoldry.

Vance is the opposite. He built his own career. He was a real marine, not a lawyer / fake navy seal like DeSantis who spent all his service years in Guantanamo collecting piss for drug tests before posing in campaign commercials as a “Top Gun” fighter pilot.

Vance questioned Trump at a time when Trump was unknown politically. Then he quickly started fighting for MAGA, all with no expectation of being rewarded. Just because he was a real patriot, a based hillbilly who wants to see good Americans win again. He was the most based senator in US history, taking up issues that were previously verboten. He defended Trump at Trump’s lowest point in 2021. This is why Charlie Kirk and Don Jr selected Vance for VP.

Your logic of “Florida is pretty nice, so I want DeSantis” only makes sense superficially. Florida would have been nice regardless of if DeSantis or Jeb Bush was governor. The population of Florida is based. The legislature is really who achieved most of Florida’s real Ws.

Look closer and you’ll find DeSantis is a fraud, despised by every single real MAGA warrior in the fight, from Trump himself, to Roger Stone, to Laura Loomer. The people who know DeSantis the best hate him the most. 

He has an appalling record of cucking out on a wide variety of issues from banning fracking, to supporting statehood for Puerto Rico, to removing confederate statues. He has no spine. He blows wherever the voters want him to go. This is tolerable in Florida where the electorate is based. When he’s in front of a national electorate, he will revert back to being the Mitt Romney moderate cuck that he was in congress who was simping for Paul Ryan and George Bush, voting against Trump’s border wall because it “cost too much.”

By the way, you know all those shills telling people not to vote in the midterms? Most of them are DeSantis people. They are trying to sabotage the midterms for MAGA so that DeSantis gains a lane to run in 2028. He tried the same thing in 2022, where his network of bots, trolls and shills attempted to sabotage every MAGA candidate in the midterms, most notably, Kari Lake.
